Asset type: existing vocabulary card, minimal edit
Input image: edit target. Keep the existing cat-reference illustration style, soft internal shading, violet outlines, subject colors, exact drawing details and canvas dimensions. Do not redraw or restyle the subject. 
Requested edit: Change ONLY the empty outer background from its pale pink/lavender tint to pure opaque white (#FFFFFF), matching the older cards. Preserve the foreground illustration exactly as supplied: same silhouette, pose, size, placement, contours, color, soft shading, surface details and expression. Do not change any part of the drawing, including pale highlights or cream/violet shading inside it. Fill all genuine empty background regions with white, including the space around the subject and any open holes. No shadow, halo, tint, vignette, texture, added props or labels.
Output exactly one square card; opaque white backdrop, not transparency. The new background color is the only general style change. Do not add logos or text.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Japanese vocabulary card showing the action of cutting paper
Input image is the STYLE/OBJECT EDIT TARGET. Keep its orange-handled scissors, lavender metal blades, clean violet outlines and soft cat-reference shading, but CORRECT the mechanical scene.
Primary request: Show a plausible scissors cut entering the RIGHT EDGE of one sheet of paper. Handles stay to the right, pivot just outside the sheet edge, blade tips point LEFT into the sheet. The scissors are only partly open. The paper is physically BETWEEN the two blades: one blade is in front, the other is partly occluded behind the sheet. Their cutting edges meet at a single clear active cutting point near the right edge, just forward of the pivot. The already-cut slit runs from that point BACK to the right edge toward the handles. A narrow offcut strip peels DOWN and RIGHT on the already-cut/handle side and remains attached at the active cutting point. The main uncut sheet extends left of the tips. A short subtle dashed guide may extend ahead to the left, aligned with the cut.
Important: do not put a detached strip floating in front of the blade tips; do not draw scissors simply lying on top of an intact sheet; do not make the paper weave impossibly through the handles or cross the pivot. No extra blades, fake holes, torn jagged paper, arrows, words, labels or hands. The action should read immediately at thumbnail size.
Backdrop: pure opaque WHITE (#FFFFFF), matching the earlier cards. No lavender canvas tint. Preserve the established illustration style and overall centered scale; changing the scissors-paper interaction is authorized. Output one square card.
assets.visualReview: Correct scissors/paper interaction: paper between partly open blades, cut at sheet edge, offcut trailing behind the cutting point; white background.

references.role: edit target; preserve foreground design and shading; apply only requested edits
